create_folder.title: Make folder
create_folder.description: Make a folder and say who reads it: public, members, chosen groups or staff.

args.description: Who made the folder, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

list_folders.title: List folders
list_folders.description: List folders, newest first, optionally narrowed to one audience.

create_file.title: Make file
create_file.description: Make the record of a file in a folder. Its bytes arrive as its first version.

args.description: The folder the file sits in. The address decides, not the body.
Who made the record, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

get_file.title: Read file
get_file.description: Read one file's record, with the number of its current version.

add_version.title: Upload version
add_version.description: Upload the next version of a file. The earlier versions stay in its history.

args.description: The file this is a version of. The address decides, not the body.
Who uploaded, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

get_settings.title: Read settings
get_settings.description: Read the effective files settings and the layer that set each: the longest side a photo is shrunk to, photos per question, and the largest file.

list_versions.title: List versions
list_versions.description: List a file's versions, newest first.

args.description: The file whose history to list.
